svg.title: Selected public-repository commits
svg.desc: Isometric public commit calendar from 31 Oct 2025 to 30 Oct 2026. 365 dated cells include zero-count days; 195 commits across 29 active days. Cell height is linear within this snapshot, at 3 SVG units per commit, with a maximum bar height of 75 units. Source scope: Distinct commits linked to DoArtMonteiro on selected public repositories' default branches; dated by author timestamp in UTC. This is a subset of GitHub activity, not the full profile graph. Aggregate counts do not measure work quality or intensity.
svg.text: Data through 30 Oct 2026 · 195 commits across 29 active days; 365 dated days.

Source scope: Distinct commits linked to DoArtMonteiro on selected public repositories' default branches; dated by author timestamp in UTC. This is a subset of GitHub activity, not the full profile graph. All 365 dated cells are shown, including zeros; totals do not measure work quality or intensity.
Linear within this snapshot: 3 SVG units per commit; maximum bar 75 units. Exact counts appear in each cell description.
